entities.summary: Gravenhurst is a town in the Muskoka Region of Ontario, Canada. It is located approximately 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) south of Bracebridge, Ontario. The Town of Gravenhurst includes a large area of the District of Muskoka. The town centre borders Lake Muskoka and Gull Lake. Kahshe Lake is situated 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) south of the town.
